caption:
Thursday notification 📱 Swipe to find your element.

Today is Yin Earth over Fire: a warm, fertile field. Good for growing plans and looking after people; easy to take on too much.

Your element is the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find it free at the link in bio.

Which message hit a bit too close? Tell us below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #selfdiscovery #metaphysics #personalgrowth #chinesemetaphysics #bazi #fiveelements #chineseastrology
day_line: A warm field under a reaching branch. Fertile and generous: good for growing plans, easy to take on too much.

lines.Yang Wood: Pack lunch today. Your wallet notices, and so does your next holiday.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone mentions a deal or a lead today. Ask one more question before you say yes.
lines.Yang Fire: Your ideas are loud today. Great for the meeting, less great for the family chat.
lines.Yin Fire: Small treat, big mood. Get the kaya toast and skip the guilt trip.
lines.Yang Earth: Everyone wants the same thing today: the last seat, the window slot. Take turns.
lines.Yin Earth: An old friend texts back today. Reply properly, not just with a sticker.
lines.Yang Metal: Ask the person who's done it before. Ten minutes of advice saves you a week.
lines.Yin Metal: Quiet focus today. Headphones on, notifications off, and the work flows.
lines.Yang Water: Someone's watching how you handle things today. Stay calm; it counts later.
lines.Yin Water: Busy, busy today. Eat a proper meal before you reply to anything important.
